frequency_question: How often do central bank principals elect to implement incremental or temporary reserve ratio mandates when excess liquidity constraints arise?
membership_rule: Includes any instance where a major emerging market central bank leadership formally considered and instituted temporary incremental cash reserve requirements to manage banking system liquidity over a specific compressed window.
coverage_note: 3 named; representative of selective deployment behavior by central bank principals.
known_gaps: Excludes minor adjustments by smaller tier central banks.
skeleton: Targeted liquidity management tools deployed by major emerging market central banks during periods of acute banking sector liquidity overhang over the last 5 years.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 3 major comparable instances identified in structural liquidity management windows.
validity_reason: Central bank operational toolkits and institutional preferences for liquidity management remain stable across medium-term policy regimes.
